name: vrm-electron
description: VRM Viewer - Electron + Vite Desktop App

scripts.build: node tools/build-media-state.mjs && vite build --mode electron && copyfiles -u 1 electron/assets/loading.gif dist
scripts.build:electron: node tools/build-media-state.mjs && vite build --mode electron && copyfiles -u 1 electron/assets/loading.gif dist
scripts.build:web: vite build --mode web && copyfiles -u 2 web/assets/VRM/** dist/assets && copyfiles -u 2 web/assets/loading.gif dist/assets
scripts.package: npm run build && npx electron-forge package
scripts.make: npm run build && npx electron-forge make
